endpoint.span: The primary outcome was the incidence of AAD during 2 weeks of follow-up.

estimate.span: The proportion of patients experiencing AAD during follow-up was 19.3% (106/549) in the probiotic group vs 17.9% (103/577) in the placebo group (unadjusted odds ratio 1.10, 95% confidence interval 0.82-1.49, P = 0.53).

ci.span: The proportion of patients experiencing AAD during follow-up was 19.3% (106/549) in the probiotic group vs 17.9% (103/577) in the placebo group (unadjusted odds ratio 1.10, 95% confidence interval 0.82-1.49, P = 0.53).

treatment_strategy.span: placebo-controlled, randomized trial was conducted to evaluate the role of Lactobacillus casei DN114001 (combined as a drink with two regular yoghurt bacterial strains)

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was the incidence of AAD during 2 weeks of follow-up.

absent_reason.analysis_set: Neither abstract explicitly identifies the estimate's analysis population. Following patients 'as per protocol' does not establish a per-protocol analysis or intention-to-treat analysis.

served_mismatch: The served arm counts match the source, but the reported effect and confidence interval are an unadjusted OR, not the requested RR. No RR confidence interval is stated. The served per-protocol analysis label and requested intention-to-treat population are not established by the abstracts.

candidate_rejections.span: Both groups were followed up as per protocol.
candidate_rejections.why: This describes follow-up and cannot substantiate the served per-protocol analysis-set label.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population is described as patients aged over 55 years, but antibiotic receipt as an entry criterion is not explicitly stated; intention-to-treat status is also unstated.

notes: Only abstracts are held. BOUND applies to the reported OR and its CI; no RR or RR CI was inferred. Dose and treatment duration are unstated. The reported randomized total of 1127 differs from the arm denominators 549 and 577, which sum to 1126; the source does not explain this discrepancy.
